bundle_report.acceptance: PROVISIONAL transport train family candidate; no runtime installation or gameplay/whole-map acceptance. Blender comparison gate OPEN: this authored pilot does not choose a whole-unit-set method. Exact physical subject pivot and native Amiga A-F facing mapping remain unverified. Other units, portraits, zoom and runtime facing integration remain OPEN. Technical key atlas is not finished faction art. Negative-lobed filtering may produce K>min(N); final tint clamps RGB. bundle_report.palette_selector: Owner palette is independent of class ID/country, including captured transport train; no other family aliases.
bundle_report.profile: unit-transport-train-v1: six authored square panels row-major N,NW,SW,S,SE,NE; class family lookup CP_transTrain independently selects owner cp/ec/neutral. Source straight RGB V=max(R,G,B); q=max(0,(min(R,B)-G)/max(1,V)); t=clamp((q-.02)/.08); k=t^3*(6*t^2-15*t+10); K=k*V; N_c=(1-k)*source_c+K. Round N/K half up before filtering; alpha-zero clears RGB. Base=(N_R,N_G,N_B,A), tint-energy mask=(K,K,K,A), never binary coverage. Whole-panel pixel-edge affine source anchor=(cell/2,49*cell/96), logical anchor=(48,49), top-left offset=(0,-9), inset=.8. 4x destination=(192,196)+(.8*384/cell)*(source-source_anchor); destination centers map to (d+.5-offset)/scale-.5; offset=(38.4,39.2). Unchanged compound tap budget <=4,000,000 conservative full-support axis taps, checked before allocation. Transparent zero extension, normalized premultiplied float64 separable antialiased Lanczos3, signed lobes retained, positive raw alpha unpremultiply, half-up clamped RGB/A, zero-alpha clear. Independently whole-alpha-aware Lanczos3 reduce base/mask 384->192. At each density tint=halfup(clamp(N_c+K*(palette_c/255-1),0,255)), same alpha. Spent after tint is (R,R,R,A). 2x coloured sprites are composed after plane reduction, not claimed identical to downsampled coloured 4x sprites. Required six-world-pixel zero-RGBA guard, no threshold/background removal, bounding-box crops, mirrors, rotation, per-frame scaling, unit hex clipping or light rotation. Seven-cell fixtures use decoded pinned ground PNGs first and decoded exported sprite PNGs next, stable world y/x order, ordinary image/draw Over.
